title: Learning Where to Look: Observation Policy Optimization for Thinking with Images
summary: Complex visual question answering often requires vision-language models to think with images, i.e., actively acquire local visual evidence by zooming into informative regions of high-resolution images. Our error analysis shows that many failures in this setting originate from incorrect observation actions, where the model fails to localize key regions or obtain crops that contain sufficient evidence for answering. We further observe that bounding-box tokens exhibit substantially higher generation entropy than ordinary language tokens, indicating high uncertainty when the model decides where to look. However, existing reinforcement learning methods based on final-answer rewards provide only trajectory-level feedback, making it difficult to assign precise credit to the observation actions. We propose Observation Policy Optimization (OPO), an RL algorithm for optimizing observation actions in tool-augmented thinking with images. OPO consists of two core modules. First, Uncertainty-Guided Observation Branching (UOB) treats each image zoom-in tool call as an observation event and selectively branches at high-uncertainty, low-redundancy events during rollout, enabling efficient exploration of alternative cropping decisions and their resulting visual evidence. Second, Evidence-Localized Advantage Attribution (ELAA) compares sibling branches using local evidence-sufficiency rewards and assigns credit only to the corresponding observation-action tokens. By decoupling observation-action optimization from trajectory-level outcome supervision, OPO improves visual evidence acquisition and further enhances visual reasoning performance. Experiments show that OPO consistently improves Qwen3-VL models across scales and achieves competitive performance against larger models and tool-augmented baselines. Code is publicly available.

AI.brief_summary: 该工作针对「thinking with images」中 VLM 主动放大局部区域获取视觉证据的观察动作，发现失败多源于定位错误或裁剪证据不足、且边界框 token 生成熵偏高，提出 OPO：以不确定性引导在高熵观察事件处分叉探索替代裁剪，并用局部证据充分性奖励对同源分支做优势归因，把信用只分配给观察动作 token。

title: LOLPlay: Benchmarking Real-Time Visual Agents in League of Legends
summary: Visual agents need to coordinate reasoning and action while their environment evolves during inference. We introduce LOLPlay, a benchmark in native \emph{League of Legends} with 36 champion-specific tasks spanning resource management, combat, cooperation, and objectives. Agents interact through screenshots and mouse--keyboard actions; automated initialization and 82 executable subgoal checks distinguish partial progress from completion. Across 324 task evaluations of three models at three reasoning-effort settings, GPT-6 Astra achieves the highest task success rate of 25.0\% at low and medium effort, and the highest subgoal success rate of 40.3\% at medium effort. However, high effort improves neither metric over low effort for any model. For Astra, longer requests leave fewer interaction rounds, suggesting a cost to additional reasoning in real-time control. Trajectories reveal incomplete subgoal composition and actions executing after the observed scene changes, motivating agents that combine visual reasoning with timely action.

title: Dr. No: Feature Steering for Abstention in Vision-Language Models
summary:
Large foundation models often answer even when the available visual or textual evidence is insufficient to support a reliable conclusion. This failure to abstain makes them hard to trust in high-stakes or information-seeking settings, where a confident but unsupported answer can be worse than no answer at all. It also raises a natural question: can the internal mechanisms behind this behaviour be identified and controlled at inference time? We present Dr. No, a feature-steering approach that mines sparse autoencoder (SAE) features associated with abstention and commitment, then modulates a small set of them during the prefill pass, without retraining the base model.
  Dr. No is evaluated on LLaVA-1.6 Mistral 7B across multimodal abstention benchmarks, including UNK-VQA and MM-UPD, and additionally benchmarked on language reasoning tasks using Qwen3.5-2B on AbstentionBench subsets. Against multiple uncertainty-based abstention baselines, feature steering achieves a more favourable balance between correct answering and appropriate abstention than post-hoc rejection methods. The gains are strongest on UNK-VQA and on MM-UPD cases involving image--question or question--answer incompatibility, and transfer most clearly to mathematical reasoning subsets of AbstentionBench. However, performance is more limited on absent-answer detection and retrieval-heavy multi-hop QA, such as MuSiQue. These results suggest that sparse internal features provide lightweight control handles for shaping uncertainty-aware behaviour in foundation models, while also showing that abstention control is source-dependent rather than governed by a single universal signal.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出 Dr. No，用稀疏自编码器（SAE）挖掘与「拒答/强行作答」相关的内部特征，在 prefill 阶段对少量特征做干预而无需重训，并在 LLaVA-1.6 与 Qwen3.5-2B 的多模态、语言推理拒答基准上评估。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接对应 LVR 中 STOP 决策与「证据是否充足」的内部状态刻画：其特征级干预结果为视觉证据不足时如何读出并控制停止信号提供了可核查线索，也提示拒答信号可能依来源而异而非单一通用信号。

title: FlowBench: Counterfactual Imagination Training for Spatial Intelligence
summary: Humans imagine scene changes under hypothetical motions, an ability central to spatial reasoning and robotic planning. However, this capability remains underexplored in vision-language models and world models. We formalize this capability as Counterfactual Spatial Imagination (CSI) and introduce FlowBench, a resource for training and evaluating both, with 428K training examples spanning simulated and real-world scenes, household environments and tabletop manipulation, and diverse question types. A scalable, fully automatic pipeline pairs each hypothetical motion with spatial questions and, in simulation, exact outcome frames and optical flow. For VLMs, proprietary models exhibit an imagination gap, performing worse when motion outcomes must be inferred than when observed, and open-source models perform near chance; fine-tuning Qwen3-VL-8B on FlowBench-Sim-Train raises its accuracy by 29.5 percentage points in simulation and 16.9 on real images, a strong sim-to-real transfer. For world models, training on FlowBench-Sim improves text-to-flow prediction for all four model families we test, raising the accuracy of Psi-0.6 from 52.1% to 61.7%. FlowBench thus serves as a training and evaluation resource for both. Code and datasets are released at https://github.com/liuyifan22/FlowBench.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出「反事实空间想象」（CSI）任务并构建 FlowBench，用 428K 自动生成样本为 VLM 与世界模型提供训练与评测资源，涵盖仿真与真实场景、假设运动后的空间问答及仿真中的真实结果帧与光流。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「想象差距」诊断（模型推断运动结果时明显差于观察时）与微调后 29.5 个百分点的提升，直接涉及 VLM 内部是否保留并使用实体关系与几何信息，可作为检验视觉证据与空间状态表示的评价素材。

title: Computer-Use Agents Gain Little Benefit from a World Model When Conditioned on Tutorials
summary: Recent work has improved computer-use agents (CUAs) by combining retrieved task-relevant tutorials and look-ahead planning using world models with MLLM judges. However, the contribution of each component -- tutorials, the judge, and the world model -- to overall improvement has not been evaluated in isolation. To fill this gap, we first construct OSWorld-Tutorial and ScienceBoard-Tutorial: two datasets for CUAs with curated multimodal tutorials, covering everyday and scientific domains. We then propose RAG-PolicyJudge (RAG-PJ), a policy-judge framework for CUAs conditioned on task-specific tutorials: the policy proposes candidate actions, and the judge selects among them. To isolate the effect of world models given tutorials, we compare RAG-PJ with and without common world models: using either zero-shot text-based descriptions of next states or an oracle that returns ground-truth visual observations. We find that RAG-PJ gains little benefit from these rollouts when tutorials are present, even with perfect visual futures. This suggests prior world-model gains in tutorial-conditioned methods come mainly from tutorial understanding and the judge's ability to select the proposed actions, rather than from predicted rollouts. Error analysis reveals that the bottleneck is not rollout fidelity, but the judge's ability to reason over future states and recognize task completion. This highlights the need to improve not just next-state prediction in world models, but also reasoning over their predicted rollouts. Datasets and code are available at https://github.com/realjoenguyen/RAGPJ-official.

AI.brief_summary: 论文构建带多模态教程的 CUA 数据集，提出由 policy 提议动作、judge 选择的 RAG-PolicyJudge 框架，并在有教程条件下对比无世界模型、文本预测下一状态与 oracle 真实视觉未来，发现 rollout 带来的收益很小。
AI.relevance_reason: 该负结果直接拆解了教程、judge 与预测视觉未来的贡献，指出瓶颈在 judge 对未来状态的推理和完成判定，可供核查 LVR 中「预测状态是否被真正使用」、视觉旁路及验证器作用。

title: ScienceVision: Can AI Observe and Reason Like a Scientist?
summary: Scientific discovery builds on accurate observations interpreted through domain knowledge and reasoning. For scientific 3D data, this requires understanding structures and spatial relationships, from protein contacts to anatomical organization. Existing multimodal benchmarks largely evaluate text and 2D images, while scientific 3D evaluations vary in representations and protocols across disciplines, limiting cross-disciplinary comparison. To assess these foundational capabilities, we introduce ScienceVision, a cross-domain benchmark for scientific 3D understanding and reasoning through expert-level visual question answering (VQA). We construct 250 questions, with 50 each from Biology, Chemistry, Medical Imaging, Mechanical CAD, and Architecture, through a pipeline combining synthetic question generation with domain-expert review and annotation. Each task pairs a native 3D artifact with a scientific question, a specified response format, and a task-specific reference answer, requiring domain knowledge to be applied to geometric or topological evidence. We evaluate 12 models on the same questions in three settings: visual question answering with native 3D artifacts accessed through an agent harness's file and code-execution tools; the same workflow augmented with expert-inspired viewer inspection and measurement tools exposed through the Model Context Protocol (MCP); and visual question answering from prescribed rendered 2D images using an agent harness. All settings use the same task-specific deterministic final-answer scoring. The inspection environment supports view changes, target isolation, and slice inspection. In this main comparison, the best mean answer score is 0.53 out of 1. Mean scores in the native-artifact workflow without additional MCP tools exceed those in the rendered-image workflow for every model, by 17.2 percentage points on average.

AI.brief_summary: 提出跨领域基准 ScienceVision，含 250 道专家级 3D 科学视觉问答，覆盖生物、化学、医学影像、机械 CAD 与建筑；在原生 3D 文件、MCP 查看与测量工具、预设 2D 渲染三种设置下评测 12 个模型。
AI.relevance_reason: 该基准围绕几何与拓扑证据的观察和推理，提供视角切换、目标隔离、切片与测量等工具化观察条件，可供核查视觉细节是否被保留和使用，以及「LOOK」式证据获取的收益与成本；本身不涉及 latent 状态生成。

title: Co-Occurrence Priors Override Visual Spatial Evidence: Understanding False Alarms in Vision-Language Models for Construction Struck-By Hazard Detection
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly support construction hazard monitoring, yet their frequent false alarms remain poorly understood. This study investigates whether false struck-by hazard warnings arise from failures in object recognition, spatial relation encoding, or hazard decisions dominated by learned co-occurrence priors. We evaluated Qwen2.5-VL-7B and InternVL3.5-8B using 355 counterfactual worker-excavator scene pairs with controlled spatial proximity and worker-removal variants, combining behavioral analysis, internal representation probing, causal interventions, and decision correction. Both models recognized the entities and encoded their spatial relations (out-of-fold AUROC: 0.82 and 0.91), assigning higher hazard scores to near than far scenes in 79% and 73% of pairs. Nevertheless, 74% and 100% of far scenes were falsely classified as hazardous. Removing the worker reduced Qwen's hazard rate to 11%, while worker presence exerted 2.4- and 3.2-times greater influence on hazard scores than spatial proximity in the respective models. Attention-head interventions, neuron-level interventions, and activation steering failed to eliminate this co-occurrence bias. However, conditioning hazard decisions on the model's own spatial-relation representation improved Qwen's specificity from 0.36 to 0.58 at matched sensitivity, outperforming threshold recalibration. These findings reveal that VLM struck-by false alarms stem primarily from decision-making failures rather than deficiencies in object recognition or spatial encoding, suggesting that future efforts should prioritize conditioning hazard decisions on encoded spatial evidence rather than further improving visual recognition alone.

AI.brief_summary: 该研究用 355 组受控反事实工人—挖掘机场景，结合行为分析、内部表示探测、因果干预与决策修正，检验 VLM 施工碰撞危险误报究竟源于目标识别、空间关系编码失败，还是共现先验主导的决策。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文发现空间关系已被内部表示编码（AUROC 0.82/0.91）却未被危险判断使用，且注意头、神经元干预与激活引导均无法消除共现偏置，仅把决策条件化于自身空间表示才有效，这与「视觉证据是否真正进入最终输出、表示—决策脱耦」的主线问题直接相关，值得核查其探测与干预设计。

title: Say the Same, Act Differently: Diagnosing and Steering Text-Action Divergence in Reasoning VLAs
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. 23 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables
summary: Reasoning vision-language-action (VLA) models pair physical control with natural-language rationales that supervisors can read to monitor embodied safety. Prior attacks on VLA reasoning corrupt the rationale itself and leave visible evidence in the text. We show that visual perturbations can instead alter the physical action while keeping the generated rationale word-for-word identical. At the shared text/action interface of Alpamayo for driving and InstructVLA for manipulation, our text-neutral action-subspace (TNAS) diagnostic shows that the locally most action-sensitive direction is nearly orthogonal to the active text-loss gradients, with 1.87% and 5.28% norm overlap. At equal hidden-state perturbation norms across both models, interventions along this text-neutral residual shift actions 4.64x to 47.8x more than text-gradient perturbations, whereas text-gradient perturbations induce 21.2x to 277x more text drift. Steering visual perturbations along this direction reaches the same decoupling from the image. Across 154 obstacle-annotated driving scenes in Alpamayo, TNAS-guided attacks induce a new collision under a word-for-word identical rationale in 52.6% of scenes under full-image perturbations and 35.1% under a localized forward-camera patch, compared with 4.55% for unguided action attacks. Relative to a text-preserving baseline, TNAS guidance raises exact rationale preservation from 83.0% to 89.5% and cuts teacher-forced text drift by 68.4% at a comparable collision rate. In InstructVLA, TNAS guidance cuts text drift by 40.5% and preserves the exact response on 85.0% of examples alongside a 1.73-unit action-chunk shift. An unchanged rationale therefore cannot certify a safe action, so monitors for reasoning VLAs must verify the predicted action channel directly.

title: GroundSeek-CXR: Retrospective Evaluation-Guided Active Observation Framework for Multi-Label Chest Radiography Diagnosis
summary: Chest radiography (CXR) diagnosis is critical for thoracic disease assessment, yet challenged by the need to identify subtle lesions and co-occurring abnormalities across regions. While recent vision-language models can actively observe local regions, existing preference-based methods supervise each observation by its immediate effect on the current diagnosis, failing to capture how each observation and stopping decision contributes to the final diagnosis. To address this issue, we propose GroundSeek-CXR, an active CXR diagnosis framework that learns observation and stopping decisions by retrospectively evaluating them with the final diagnosis. Specifically, we first devise a Retrospective Diagnostic Evaluation (RDE) that scores observation and stop candidates from offline Monte Carlo tree search through independent continuations. Moreover, we design a Retrospective Gap-weighted Preference Optimization (RGPO) that learns from retrospective-score preferences weighted by their score gaps, prioritizing actions that improve diagnostic accuracy. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our GroundSeek-CXR framework outperforms state-of-the-art methods, and improves abnormal-image sample-F1 by 4.48% over immediate-score preference learning.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 GroundSeek-CXR，用离线蒙特卡洛树搜索对观察与停止动作做回顾性诊断评估，并以分差加权的偏好优化训练主动观察，用于多标签胸片诊断。

title: Entropy-Gated Dynamic Rectification for Object Hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) routinely name objects that are absent from the image. Latent steering can reduce this failure in one model forward pass, but a fixed gate treats early and late decoding steps by the same criterion. We observe that predictive entropy varies sharply within free-running generation, while states that commit to short answers occupy a narrow, confident band. We exploit this temporal mismatch by using uncertainty as a causally available, token-local control signal for an existing steering gate. We propose Entropy-Gated Dynamic Rectification (EGDR), which lowers the intervention threshold when entropy derived from the preceding step's already available logits is high and retains the calibrated operating point when it is low. On LLaVA-1.5-7B, the underlying static gate lowers CHAIR CS/CI from 53.00/15.30 to 32.00/14.30; replacing only its constant threshold with EGDR further lowers them to 29.00/13.60. At a matched 58% intervention rate, the corresponding static control obtains 30.50/14.00. The gain over the static gate holds on LLaVA-NeXT-7B and grows with the generation budget, while POPE scores and general multimodal capability remain effectively unchanged. EGDR requires no additional model forward pass and adds roughly 2% measured latency. Our code is available at https://github.com/alvi-uiu/EGDR.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 EGDR：用前一步已可得 logits 的预测熵动态下调 latent steering 门控阈值，在单次前向内抑制 LVLM 物体幻觉，并在 LLaVA-1.5/NeXT 上报告 CHAIR 指标改善。

title: SEEK-VAU: Towards Evidence-Faithful Video Anomaly Understanding via Agentic Search
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (main conference track). 27 pages, 5 figures
summary: Most video anomaly understanding (VAU) systems still infer anomaly judgments from evidence collected in a feed-forward way under predefined rules, typically sampled frames, or events clustered from such frames. This protocol fails when the collected evidence is incomplete under imperfect predefined rules, because once reasoning begins the model can no longer search for the missing evidence. We address this limitation with SEEK-VAU, which reframes VAU as an agentic search-and-verify interaction protocol under a bounded search budget: instead of passively reasoning over pre-collected evidence, the policy actively gathers evidence across the three stages of an anomaly event chain (precursor, trigger, and aftermath) and verifies its sufficiency before finalization, turning event-chain completeness into an explicit design rather than an outcome of predefined rules. A bounded budget caps the cost of this search, but does not by itself teach the policy where to look or when to stop. To make this behavior learnable, we introduce evidence-faithful counterfactual verification (EFCV), which rewards selected evidence that remains supportive, compact, and necessary under counterfactual verification. We further introduce SEEK-Bench, featuring video-level episodes with temporal interval annotations, semantic QA and event-chain stage labels. Together, SEEK-VAU and SEEK-Bench establish a strong foundation for evidence-faithful and actively verifiable VAU.

AI.brief_summary: 论文将视频异常理解重构为有限预算下的智能体式搜索—验证协议，主动采集异常事件链的前兆、触发与后果证据，并以证据忠实的反事实验证奖励训练策略，同时提出 SEEK-Bench。

title: SPOD: Recovering Suppressed Temporal Evidence in Video-LLMs via Single-Pass Orthogonal Decomposition
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 1 table. Accepted to ACM Multimedia 2026 (MM '26)
summary: Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs) have achieved strong performance on many video understanding tasks, yet remain vulnerable to temporal hallucination in time-sensitive reasoning scenarios such as scene transition understanding and event ordering. Existing solutions either require costly retraining or introduce inefficient multi-pass inference and external supervision at test time. In this work, we show that temporal evidence is already encoded in Video-LLM hidden representations but is not fully exploited during standard inference. Motivated by this observation, we propose Single-Pass Orthogonal Decomposition (SPOD), a training-free framework that recovers suppressed temporal evidence through analytical hidden-state manipulation in a single forward pass. SPOD consists of two components: Frame Distinctiveness Analysis (FDA), which identifies salient frames from middle-layer hidden-state geometry, and Temporal Delta Subspace (TDS), which constructs orthogonal temporal and prior subspaces from weighted inter-frame hidden-state differences. By decomposing final hidden states into temporal, prior, and residual components and rescaling them independently, SPOD enhances dynamic information, suppresses static appearance bias, and preserves complementary information. Experiments on VidHalluc, EventHallusion, and VideoMMMU show that SPOD consistently outperforms strong inference-time baselines across temporal reasoning tasks and model architectures while retaining near-vanilla inference efficiency. These results suggest that improving temporal reasoning in Video-LLMs may depend not only on additional supervision, but also on recovering temporal evidence already present in their internal representations. Our code is available at https://github.com/VioAgnes/SPOD.

AI.brief_summary: 论文指出 Video-LLM 的隐藏表示中已编码时间证据但未被充分利用，提出免训练的单次前向正交分解框架：从中间层几何筛选显著帧、构造时间与先验子空间，并在最终隐藏状态中重缩放各分量以增强动态信息、抑制静态外观偏差。

title: VisSearch-Bench: Evaluating Long Horizon Visual Search in Multimodal Agents
summary: Multimodal agents use web and image tools to answer questions beyond their internal knowledge. Some search tasks use images mainly to identify an initial entity, then rely on text retrieval. These tasks offer limited insight into how agents connect information across images, objects, and search steps. We therefore focus on visual context management. This involves organizing and using visual information and linking it to other findings during search. Visually intensive tasks require agents to combine object appearance, local details, or spatial relations with external information. We introduce VisSearch-Bench, with 204 human-written tasks across 7 main domains and 25 subdomains. It covers Set-wise Visual Search, Sequential Visual Search, Hybrid Wide-Deep Search, Competitive Visual Disambiguation, and Visual-Structure-Guided Search. Each task provides a reference answer, traceable evidence, and scoring rules. Accuracy measures complete task success, while Process Score measures the correctness and completeness of individual results and subquestion answers. Across 16 multimodal models, the best system fully solves only 26.47% of tasks, even with search tools. These results highlight the challenge of linking visual evidence with search results to produce complete answers.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 VisSearch-Bench，包含 204 个人工编写任务、7 大领域 25 个子领域，覆盖集合式、序列式、宽深混合、竞争消歧与结构引导五类视觉搜索；每项任务配有参考答案、可追溯证据与评分规则，用准确率与过程分评估 16 个多模态模型的视觉上下文管理与证据链接能力。

title: Heads That Write, Not Just Point: Image Retrieval Heads in Vision-Language Models
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) can process interleaved text and multiple images in a single context, but how they internally identify the image relevant to a question remains poorly understood. We study this grounding step as in-context image retrieval and introduce ICIR-MCQ, a controlled probe for head-level analysis of image retrieval. Using each head's attention mass over image-token spans, we first identify sparse pointer heads that reliably point to the target image. These heads transfer beyond the probe: a single pointer head is competitive with external vision-language retrievers on a naturalistic multi-image retrieval benchmark, showing that LVLMs contain a strong internal image retrieval signal. Attention alone, however, shows where a head reads from, not what its output passes on to later layers, so we introduce a complementary output-side analysis. For each head, we train a lightweight image retriever on its value-weighted output and use it to identify writer heads, whose outputs contain enough information to identify the target image. Surprisingly, the pointer and writer criteria select substantially different head sets, with only 35 to 47 heads overlapping among the top-100 heads under each criterion. Targeted set-partition ablations show that the heads most important for standard multi-image inference are concentrated in this pointer-writer intersection, while heads selected by only one criterion show less consistent separation from random-head controls. The most consistent causal effects arise from heads selected by both the attention-based pointer and output-side writer criteria. Code and data: https://github.com/parkquasar/Image-Retrieval-Heads.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究 LVLM 如何在上下文中识别与问题相关的图像，提出 ICIR-MCQ 探针做头级分析：先用注意力质量找出稀疏的 pointer heads，再在各头 value-weighted 输出上训练轻量检索器以识别 writer heads，并通过集合划分消融比较两类头的因果作用。
AI.relevance_reason: 将「注意力指向何处」与「输出是否携带可识别图像的信息」显式分离，并给出指针–写者交集更关键的因果证据，与视觉证据筛选、注意力结构对 latent 相似度和内部状态内容的影响直接相关，值得优先核查其头级指标与消融设置。

title: VIGOR: Visual Gain Ordering for Hallucination Mitigation in Multimodal Discrete Diffusion Language Models
summary: Multimodal discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs) generate responses through iterative mask prediction and offer a promising alternative to autoregressive large vision-language models. However, they still suffer from hallucination, producing outputs that are plausible under language priors but insufficiently grounded in the image. We argue that hallucination in multimodal dLLMs is not only a token prediction problem, but also a premature commitment problem: during iterative denoising, some masked positions are unmasked too early because their confidence is driven more by language priors than by visual evidence, and these early commitments can bias later generation. To address this issue, we propose Visual Gain Ordering (VIGOR), a training-free and plug-and-play inference strategy that reorders masked positions according to counterfactual visual evidence. At each denoising step, VIGOR compares the confidence of each candidate token under the original image-conditioned pass and an additional visual-ablation pass, and prioritizes positions whose predictions are more strongly supported by the image. Experiments on LLaDA-V and Lumina-DiMOO show that VIGOR consistently reduces hallucination and improves multimodal reasoning performance across benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/THU-BPM/Vigor.

AI.brief_summary: 该文研究多模态离散扩散语言模型在迭代掩码去噪中的幻觉问题，提出无训练、即插即用的 VIGOR：通过对比原图条件与视觉消融两次预测的置信度，重新排序掩码位置的解码顺序，优先解码更依赖图像证据的位置。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接涉及视觉证据是否真正进入生成状态与过早承诺问题；其「反事实视觉增益」排序可供核查 LVR 中视觉旁路、证据筛选与并行/扩散解码停止决策的关系。

title: One Mistake, Three Layers: Persistence Rules Under Depth Correlation
summary:
Probing frozen representations layer by layer is now standard practice, but reporting when a signal first becomes decodable requires a rule for reading a depth curve, and the obvious rule is wrong. On synthetic curves with known ground truth, requiring a probe score to exceed a null-calibrated threshold for three consecutive stages reports an onset nineteen stages early under transformer-like depth correlation, with every resample returning an onset. The failure follows from correlation between neighboring layers, a hazard known in neuroimaging but not, to our knowledge, checked for depth curves.
  We give an estimator whose error rate is calibrated rather than assumed. Null trajectories are built by permuting labels within each evaluation unit and holding each permutation fixed across depth, preserving the correlation structure the rule must survive; thresholds are per-layer order statistics; and the persistence requirement is calibrated rather than chosen.
  Applied to pocket information in a frozen co-folding trunk, stratifying 1,820 post-cutoff targets by protein-family and pocket familiarity, the five-stage rule fires on 4 to 7 per cent of null trajectories against a nominal 5 per cent and the three-stage rule on 12 to 17: the synthetic failure reproduces on real data. Pocket membership is decodable above threshold at all 48 blocks in all four regimes, so the onset cannot discriminate them; the pre-declared accumulation depth does, and is latest for familiar families with structurally novel pockets in every feature set. That regime is also the weakest, by a margin surviving controls for length, pocket measure and alignment depth.
  Separately, a widely used public co-folding checkpoint loads against its own code with 128 trunk parameters missing; those would be randomly initialized, and every representation extracted would be partly noise while appearing normal.

AI.brief_summary: 论文针对逐层探针深度曲线的「信息何时可解码」判定规则：在合成曲线上证明相邻层相关会使「连续多阶段超阈值」规则大幅提前报告 onset，继而提出以层内标签置换构建零轨迹、逐层次序统计量阈值和校准化持续性要求的估计器，并在冻结 co-folding 主干的 pocket 信息上复现该偏差；文末另指出某公开 checkpoint 加载时缺失 128 个主干参数。
AI.relevance_reason: 其对深度相关下零分布校准与累积深度的处理，可供核查 LVR 中「视觉或任务信息在第几层出现」类探针结论及层间相似度读取方式，checkpoint 加载缺失的提醒也关系到表征抽取的噪声污染，但研究对象并非视觉推理本身。

title: On the Primacy Bias in RLVR Training
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Reward (RLVR) has emerged as a promising approach for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of large language models. However, it still remains unclear whether RLVR can extend reasoning capabilities beyond what is already encoded in the base model. In this paper, we study this question through the lens of primacy bias: the tendency of models to over-rely on already-learned representations, disproportionately improving performance on problems they already handle well while underexploring harder ones that require departing from those representations. Through our controlled experiments and large-scale analysis, we show that RLVR training on mixed data tends to further sharpen performance on easier problems while yielding only marginal gains on harder ones. We find that although hard problems lead to modest gains overall, they are actually the ones that help most in expanding the model's reasoning capabilities and pushing the representations. However, prolonged training on these hard problems may also hurt and lead to forgetting on easy problems. These findings help to better understand some of the prior conflicting observations about RLVR, specifically, why on (OOD) domains where the base model performs poorly, improvements on hard problems can expand reasoning; while on well-trained domains, forgetting can reduce performance and mask genuine gains obtained from hard problems.

AI.brief_summary: 论文从 primacy bias 视角研究 RLVR 能否真正扩展基座模型的推理能力：混合数据训练主要强化已掌握题目，难题虽总体增益有限，却最能推动表示扩展，但长期训练难题会造成简单题遗忘。
AI.relevance_reason: 纯文本 RLVR 虽非视觉研究，但其关于数据难度配比、表示偏离与灾难性遗忘的分析，可供核查 LVR 训练中 latent 状态能否摆脱既有表示及监督分配问题。

title: Interpretable Early Termination of Web Navigation Agents via Closed Sequential Pattern Mining
comment: In online proceedings of AI Agents for Discovery in the Wild (AID-Wild) Workshop at ACM CAIS 2026
summary: Web navigation agents built on open-weight language models fail often and fail late, with most of the tokens spent after the trajectory has become unrecoverable. Recent work has shown that early termination is a viable cost-reduction strategy, but existing approaches produce opaque termination decisions that do not support diagnosis or human oversight. In this work we apply closed sequential pattern mining (BIDE+) to K-step prefixes of agent execution traces to produce a small, human-reviewable failure-signature library that organizes into a four-category failure taxonomy with associated repair recommendations. We use a multi-variant evaluation protocol that explicitly removes contamination artifacts (zero-step crashes and trivially separable single-step successes) so that reported detection accuracy reflects behavioral discrimination rather than trace-length distributions. We evaluate our methodology on 1,544 MiniWoB++ traces collected from three open-weight language models, achieving the best F1 at K=3 on the Exclude-errors configuration across eight methods (0.717), recovering 88% of test-set failures within three steps, and supporting an early-termination policy that saves 26.3% of tokens at 92% precision.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究 web navigation agent 的可解释早期终止：对执行轨迹的 K 步前缀做 closed sequential pattern mining（BIDE+），得到小型、可人工审阅的失败签名库，并整理为四类失败分类与修复建议；在 1,544 条 MiniWoB++ 轨迹上以多配置协议剔除污染样本后比较八种方法的检测效果，并给出省 token 的早停策略。
AI.relevance_reason: 基于前缀的失败签名识别与早停策略，可能为 LVR 中「STOP」决策（何时终止推理、依据何种可解释信号判定失败）提供线索；但其输入是文本轨迹而非视觉内部状态，能否迁移到多模态推理过程需核查。

title: Drift No More: Spectral Locking for Long-Horizon Open-Weight Multi-Agent AI
comment: Accepted at the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026)
summary: Long-horizon multi-agent systems suffer from three tightly coupled failures: task drift, role drift, and state staleness. We test the hypothesis that these share a common representational cause: agent hidden states move away from the directions encoding the active task, assigned role, and current shared state. A pilot study over 14,832 annotated turns supports this: drifted turns collapse near-uniformly across all three anchor subspaces (pairwise r = 0.72-0.78). Existing methods address these failures separately, operating at the surface-text level or treating control directions independently. We introduce ATLAS (Algebraic Task-role Locking with Adaptive Spectral Memory), a training-free intervention acting on hidden states before a token is generated. ATLAS builds a positive-semidefinite anchor kernel over task, role, and state subspaces and steers hidden states toward their shared high-coherence eigendirections; a low-rank Gram decomposition keeps this tractable. Across long-horizon memory, state maintenance, tool use, least-privilege coordination, and embodied stress tests, ATLAS outperforms prompting, retrieval, memory, and activation-steering baselines. Against A-MEM it improves memory macro-average accuracy by up to 5.7 points and reduces write/read failures by up to 31.7%/24.8%; against MemoryArena-Agent it gains up to 4.8 points. It gains 10.7-12.1 points under perturbation, reaches 93.5% role consistency, and transfers to a 72B backbone (macro-average 61.0 vs. 56.2). Ablating the joint task-role-state span costs 7.2 points against 0.8 for a matched-rank random span, indicating these directions are functionally implicated, not incidental; supplying them by prompt or retrieval recovers 4.3 points less. ATLAS is therefore a representation-level controller for open-weight multi-agent systems, complementary to output-level protocols for black-box agents.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ATLAS：一种训练无关的干预方法，在生成 token 前构造任务、角色与共享状态子空间上的半正定锚核，利用低秩 Gram 分解把隐藏状态导向三者共有的高相干预方向，以缓解长程多智能体中的任务漂移、角色漂移与状态陈旧。
AI.relevance_reason: 纯文本多智能体工作，但其「隐藏状态偏离任务相关方向」的诊断、子空间消融的功能性证据与训练无关的 hidden-state steering，可为 LVR 中 latent 状态维持、任务必要信息保留及激活层干预提供可核查的迁移线索。

title: Anchor: Augmented Cross-Layer Recurrent State for Long-Context Retrieval in Test-Time Training
comment: 10 Pages main paper with reference and appendix
summary: Parameter-efficient linearization turns a pretrained autoregressive Transformer into an efficient model by hybridizing sliding-window attention (SWA) with a constant-size recurrent memory. But does every layer's recurrent state contribute to long-context retrieval? Investigating an SWA and Test-Time Training (TTT) hybrid, we find that retrieval is sparse across depth, concentrated in a few anchor layers, and that the remaining states hold similar information expressed through layer-specific transformations. We exploit both observations in Anchor: TTT memory placed only at the anchor layers, and a cross-layer recurrent state written once and read by many layers, each through its own learned read map that realizes a layer-specific stretch and rotation, along with demonstrated generalization to other hybrid attentions. On Llama-3.1-8B and Mistral-7B, Anchor delivers 2.3-3.1x higher recall and 6.7-8.9 points higher MMLU accuracy than LoLCATs with a 10x smaller recurrent state, retains 91-95% of the teacher's MMLU accuracy, and cuts end-to-end latency by up to 4.3x relative to softmax attention.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究线性化 Transformer 的跨层循环状态如何服务长上下文检索，发现检索集中于少数 anchor 层，并提出只在 anchor 层放置 TTT memory、让多层通过各自 read map 读写共享状态。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽非视觉工作，但其对「检索能力沿深度稀疏分布」的分析和跨层共享、层适应读取机制，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态应置于哪些层、如何跨层复用并减少视觉证据损失。

title: SKILL2STEER: One-Pass Hypernetwork for Mapping Natural-Language Skills to Low-Rank Post-Block Activation Shifts
summary: Compiling a natural-language agent skill into model parameters removes the skill text from the prompt and leaves behind a small artifact that can be distributed and reused. Existing methods differ in where they inject the compiled quantity, and all of them assume that the artifact carries the content of the skill. We test that assumption. Through three controls on a retrieval agent, we find that a compiled skill shift carries a domain-general behavioural prior, not the content of the skill. A wrong skill document performs on par with the correct one, a single averaged bundle matches per-skill routing under a two-sided equivalence test, and a same-norm random direction collapses to the no-injection baseline, which shows that the trained direction stays load-bearing. We then introduce SKILL2STEER, a one-pass hypernetwork that reads a skill document once and maps it to low-rank activation shifts added at the output of every decoder block. Each skill compiles to 2.36M parameters, 9.25 times fewer than a weight-space adapter, while the base weights stay frozen and the generator runs only at compile time. The shift can be scheduled across retrieval steps and deployed as one routing-free bundle. On SearchQA, a seven-dataset benchmark, SKILL2STEER reaches 37.9 exact match, 9.8 points above the frozen model and 2.3 points above a weight-space method that ships 9.25 times more parameters per skill.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在检索型 agent 上检验「编译进参数的技能是否携带技能内容」这一假设，发现技能偏移实际更像领域通用的行为先验，并提出一次性超网络 SKILL2STEER，把技能文档映射为各解码块输出的低秩激活偏移。
AI.relevance_reason: 其错误文档、平均 bundle、同范数随机方向三组对照，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 是否真正携带视觉内容而非仅提供任务先验；低秩激活注入也可作为推理期状态注入的借鉴线索。

title: BtsPruner: Role-Aware Visual Token Pruning for Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) often process hundreds or thousands of visual tokens, resulting in substantial computational and memory overhead during inference. Existing training-free pruning methods typically estimate token importance using language-model attention, visual attention, or feature similarity. However, these methods treat visual tokens with uniform criteria and overlook that tokens may serve different roles during visual encoding. In this work, we investigate the evolution of visual token roles in LVLMs and observe that tokens progressively transition from local detail carriers to globally referenced representatives as encoding proceeds. Based on this observation, we propose BtsPruner, a training-free role-aware visual token pruning framework that preserves complementary token roles under a fixed budget. Specifically, BtsPruner first identifies the token-role transition point based on the evolution of attention concentration. It then discovers globally referenced representatives from later encoding stages and recursively retrieves local detail tokens from earlier stages to recover complementary fine-grained evidence. Extensive experiments across LLaVA-1.5, LLaVA-NeXT, Qwen-VL, InternVL, and CogVLM demonstrate that BtsPruner achieves superior performance retention under aggressive token reduction. On LLaVA-1.5-7B, BtsPruner preserves 91.6% of the dense model's performance using only 32 of 576 visual tokens (5.6%). In the high-resolution LLaVA-NeXT-7B setting, it achieves up to a 5.95x CUDA-latency speedup.

AI.brief_summary: 该文观察到 LVLM 编码过程中视觉 token 由「局部细节载体」逐步过渡为「全局被引用代表」，据此提出免训练的角色感知剪枝框架 BtsPruner：先依注意力集中度演化定位角色转变点，再从后期阶段选取全局代表并递归回溯早期阶段取回局部细节 token，在固定预算下保留互补角色，并在多个 LVLM 上验证激进剪枝下的性能保持与加速。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「角色转变点＋细节/代表互补保留」的选取策略，可供核查固定视觉 token 预算下细粒度证据如何被保留或丢失，可能与 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选、视觉旁路与信息坍缩问题相关；但该方法面向推理效率而非推理过程，联系为潜在借鉴。

title: Best-of-Depth: Learning Exploratory Dynamics in Looped Transformers
summary: Looped Transformers extend inference-time computation through repeated latent-state updates, but final-depth training does not directly encourage useful intermediate alternatives. We introduce Best-of-Depth (BoD), which trains a recurrent trajectory as a candidate set by minimizing prediction loss across depths. Different valid targets can be matched at different depths without architectural changes or depth-specific labels. An exact-match analysis connects this objective to solution coverage. On N-Queens completion and graph coloring, BoD improves coverage over final-depth and intermediate-supervision objectives. N-Queens coverage reaches 91.03%, versus 45.75% for final-depth training. Further experiments show discovery beyond the training depth and recovery of solutions withheld from teacher pools on familiar inputs. Fine-tuning a pretrained looped language model with BoD yields higher pooled code-generation success than final-depth training when programs are generated separately at evaluated fixed depths. These results support training recurrent computation for solution discovery along its trajectory.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Best-of-Depth，把循环 Transformer 的递归轨迹视为候选集，在各深度上最小化预测损失以训练中间状态，并在 N-Queens、图着色和代码生成上评估解覆盖与超出训练深度的发现能力。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽非视觉工作，但其按深度监督循环 latent 状态、以轨迹覆盖解并检验深度外泛化的做法，可能为 LVR 的循环计算训练、候选状态筛选与 STOP/深度选择提供可核查线索。

title: Cycle WAM: Coupling Action and Video through Cycle Consistency
summary: Recent advances in video modeling have driven substantial progress in world action models (WAMs). Existing approaches exploit pretrained video priors by decoding actions from latent representations or inferring them from generated videos. The underlying link is causal: robot actions produce changes in the scene, and video observations of these changes provide evidence for inferring the actions that produced them. However, existing training formulations do not by themselves ensure that actions and their predicted visual consequences are consistent, potentially limiting the use of pretrained capabilities. We treat video and action as paired modalities linked by this causal relationship and learn their correspondence through a unified training framework designed to better exploit pretrained video priors. Cycle WAM first augments video-action co-training with bidirectional conversion to reinforce cross-modal correspondence and recover forward and inverse dynamics. It then introduces a differentiable cycle-reconstruction objective to further couple the two mappings. The resulting model supports both forward and inverse dynamics, with the potential to improve performance through more effective use of pretrained video priors. Cycle WAM achieves state-of-the-art performance among comparable methods on LIBERO-Pro and substantially improves DreamZero on DROID. Comparisons with UWM characterize its inverse-dynamics performance and show sharper visual detail in the displayed forward-dynamics predictions.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出 Cycle WAM，将视频与动作视为因果配对模态，在视频-动作联合训练中加入双向转换，并引入可微的循环重建目标来耦合前向与逆向动力学，从而更充分地利用预训练视频先验；在 LIBERO-Pro 与 DROID 上报告了相应提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 其循环一致性监督可能可供核查：用「动作→视觉后果→动作」的可重建性约束内部表示，或可用于检验 latent 状态是否真正保留任务必要视觉信息、而非旁路坍缩。

title: Reducing Logprob Without Causal Verification: Diagnosing SAE-Based PII Suppression in LLMs
summary: SAE-based feature-level interventions to suppress PII leakage in LLMs are primarily evaluated by log-probability reduction. We show that this criterion cannot distinguish feature specific suppression from a magnitude artifact: a direction-agnostic effect of sufficiently large activation perturbations. Across 36 (model, layer, PII type) cases, we compare selected SAE feature interventions with coherencematched random direction controls using logprob and rank-aware metrics. While 17 cases (47%) appear successful under logprob-only evaluation, only 1 case (2.8%) passes our multimetric framework. The rest reveal two failure modes: random directions outperform selected features, and feature selection collapse across PII types. These results indicate that existing evaluations cannot verify whether interventions target causal pathways of PII leakage. A 9,000 run causal mediation feasibility study corroborates this: the verifier separates candidates reliably, but correlation-selected candidates rarely pass it. We therefore propose a new research mission for NLP: causally grounded PII suppression through circuit-level localization and causal mediation analysis.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在36个（模型、层、PII类型）组合上比较SAE特征干预与连贯性匹配的随机方向对照，发现仅以logprob下降为准则会把「足够大扰动」的幅度伪影误判为特征特异抑制，加入秩感知指标后仅1例通过，并用9000次因果中介运行说明相关性选出的特征很少通过因果验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「幅度伪影」诊断、随机方向对照与因果中介核查思路，可供核查LVR中latent内容是否被答案真正使用、以及特征贡献归因的评价设计；原文为纯文本PII抑制，迁移到多模态推理属推测。

title: Think Less, Locally: Local Preference Learning for Reasoning Compression
summary: Large reasoning models achieve strong performance on challenging tasks, but their long chain-of-thought often incurs substantial inference costs by continuing to deliberate after sufficient information has been obtained. Existing reasoning compression methods primarily operate on reasoning trajectories, paying less attention to the local decision of whether further reasoning is necessary given the current state. We propose LoCo, a local preference learning method for reasoning compression. LoCo detects candidate overthinking states from the model's own traces, freezes the corresponding reasoning prefixes, regenerates shorter verified continuations from the same states, and trains on the resulting state-conditioned preference pairs with DPO. This formulation teaches the model when to continue reasoning and when to conclude, rather than simply encouraging shorter trajectories overall. We construct training data entirely from self-generated mathematical traces and evaluate LoCo on five mathematical and three code generation benchmarks. LoCo reduces completion length by 41.7\%--45.4\% on mathematics and 23.4\%--36.3\% on code, while maintaining or improving accuracy and achieving the best AUC across all code benchmarks. LoCo consistently improves the accuracy-efficiency trade-off on mathematics and transfers effectively to code generation despite math-only training, demonstrating the cross-domain generality of local preference learning for reasoning compression. The code and model will be publicly released at https://github.com/MuyaoYuan/LoCo.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 LoCo，从模型自身的数学推理轨迹中识别「过度思考」状态，冻结对应前缀并用更短且经验证的续写构造状态条件偏好对，再以 DPO 训练模型学会在该状态下继续推理还是直接收尾，并在数学与代码基准上验证长度与准确率的权衡。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「给定当前状态判断是否还需推理」的状态级监督与偏好构造，可能为 LVR 的 STOP 决策与计算分配提供可核查的训练线索；但原文仅涉及纯文本 CoT，迁移到多模态 latent 状态需人工判断。

title: Feeling of Knowing in Large Language Models
summary: Post-training updates change what large language models (LLMs) can answer, but may leave their answerability judgments misaligned. We study this knowledge-judgment desynchronization through functional feeling of knowing (FoK), which supports selective generation, retrieval triggering, and model routing without implying subjective experience. We propose two trainable channels: a knowledge channel that changes answerability and a FoK channel that judges the current knowledge state. Three stages train them: on-policy supervised fine-tuning (OP-SFT) updates knowledge from corrected on-policy answers; knowledge-delta FoK training (K$Δ$-FT) adapts judgments across intermediate knowledge states; and FoK-guided policy optimization (FGPO) trains the subsequent answer or explanation. Factual-QA experiments, cross-dataset evaluation, and three sequential updates show that explicit FoK alignment improves judgment quality on updated knowledge. MMLU and ARC-Easy separately assess capability preservation.

AI.brief_summary: 提出功能性「感 knowledge」（FoK）框架，把知识更新与可答性判断拆为两条可训练通道，并用三阶段训练（OP-SFT、知识差量 FoK 训练、FoK 引导策略优化）让判断跟上中间知识状态。

title: Attending to Memory Writes Reduces Seed Variability in Recurrent Length Generalization
summary: Recurrent memory requires learning useful updates, but attention added to assist learning can also compromise length generalization. We study bounded delta attention: causal attention over uncorrected update proposals whose bounded correction enters the recurrent update. Its implementation in TraceRelay combines additive phase recurrence with attention computed before a parallel scan. On prefix-supervised modulo-5, trained at lengths 1--40, three findings characterize its behavior at length 80. First, upper delta attention attains $70.81\pm8.26$% accuracy across seven seeds, versus $69.21\pm22.42$% for the local-attention recurrent baseline (mean $\pm$ sample SD): a 63.2% reduction in SD with a similar mean. Upper state attention also reduces variation, reaching $74.75\pm6.24$%, so this benefit is not unique to update-level attention. Disabling the upper delta correction retains $70.62\pm8.60$%. Second, blocking gradients at the delta-attention inputs changes accuracy to $65.25\pm12.40$% in the matched seven-seed comparison, increasing SD by 50.2%. It also delays a 99% validation threshold on average among the same six seeds that reach it; the 95% threshold is reached earlier on average with input-gradient blocking across all seven seeds. Third, lower delta attention exhibits substantially less extrapolation degradation than lower state attention: 62.60% versus 19.40%, against a 71.06% baseline. Removing its correction reduces accuracy to 22.56%; its advantage over lower state attention also persists under input-gradient blocking. These observations motivate bounded update-level attention as a recurrent learning scaffold, combining reduced seed variation with less severe degradation in a placement where state attention fails.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究循环记忆中的有界 delta 注意力：对未校正的更新提案做因果注意力，再把有界校正写入循环状态；在 TraceRelay 的加法相位循环与并行扫描上以 prefix-supervised modulo-5 训练，比较上层/下层 delta 注意力与状态注意力的长度外推及七种子方差。

title: Towards an Optimal Control Foundation of Early Exits - Turnpikes and ResNets
summary: The feed-forward propagation through neural networks is crucial for training and inference. To trade off efficiency and accuracy, it has been proposed to consider intermediate outputs of hidden states as data-dependent regularization during training and, ultimately, as early-exits during inference. In this work, we analyze the joint optimization of loss functions computed for the output layer and intermediate layers using optimal control theory. We prove that ResNets trained in this joint fashion exhibit the so-called turnpike phenomenon, this implies that the number of layers required to reach a prescribed loss level is bounded from above independently of the overall network depth. This induces a similarity property across the internal representations of early-exiting networks of varying depths. We connect the turnpike to the overthinking phenomenon, and provide theoretical insights into the success of early-exit criteria derived from softmax probabilities, specifically entropy and max-probability. In a range of experiments, we demonstrate the existence and effect of turnpikes and the resulting similarity in the early-exit performance for ResNets of varying depths.

AI.brief_summary: 论文用最优控制理论分析对输出层与中间层损失进行联合优化的 ResNet，证明其呈现 turnpike 现象，即达到指定损失所需层数存在与总深度无关的上界，并由此导出不同深度网络内部表示的相似性；还将该现象与 overthinking 联系，解释基于 softmax 熵和最大概率的早退准则，并用实验验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 其关于早退深度、停止准则和跨深度内部表示相似性的理论，可能为 LVR 的 STOP 决策、动态计算及 latent 相似性受深度影响等问题提供可供核查的线索；但研究对象并非视觉或多模态推理，迁移需进一步确认。

title: Perturb, Repair, Verify: Self-Play Vision-Language Verifiers for Compositional Understanding
summary: Vision-language verifiers judge whether an image faithfully matches a textual description, yet existing training pipelines typically rely on static supervision from stronger external judges or curated hard-negative data. Such supervision requires external generation or annotation, is teacher-bounded, and is difficult to adapt as model failures evolve. We introduce PROVE (Perturb-and-Repair Optimization for Vision-Language Evaluation), a self-play framework that trains verifiers through a closed perturb-verify-repair-verify loop. Starting from a known-correct image-caption pair, a Mutator introduces a typed perturbation over objects, attributes, counts, or relations. The verifier then judges the perturbed caption and provides textual feedback, which a Repairer uses to recover a faithful caption for re-verification. These two verification rounds produce structured rewards for informative mismatches and visually grounded repairs. Since perturbation, verification, and repair are role-conditioned behaviors of the same evolving multimodal backbone, updating the shared parameters also improves the verifier itself. Experiments show that PROVE improves fine-grained compositional verification across model scales and families and strengthens visual-detail robustness on the reference backbone, with limited, benchmark-dependent changes on broader multimodal tasks.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 PROVE 自博弈框架，用「扰动—验证—修复—再验证」闭环训练视觉语言验证器：由同一多模态骨干分别扮演 Mutator、Verifier 与 Repairer，对对象、属性、数量、关系施加类型化扰动，并以两轮验证产生的结构化奖励联合优化。

title: Going Deeper With Memories
summary: Byte level language models avoid tokenizer dependence and provide universal coverage, but processing every byte at full resolution is expensive. We introduce DeepMem, a causal multiscale architecture that separates semantic compression from exact byte preservation. A learned invertible subband transform constructs a hierarchy of shorter sequences, while a lossless carrier and explicit detail sidebands preserve byte identity. Fast weight memory blocks operate along the encoder, with iterative shared state computation at the compressed bottleneck, while an attention based super resolution decoder restores byte resolution representations. DeepMem achieves stronger language modeling performance than a matched byte level Transformer on FineWeb-Edu and PG19, and obtains the best macro average performance across the evaluated FLORES languages. It also improves PIQA accuracy while remaining competitive on code modeling, multiple choice reasoning, and byte level corruption robustness. Bottleneck refinement requires approximately $7{,}600\times$ fewer counted FLOPs than equivalent full resolution reasoning, while maintaining competitive evaluation throughput.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 DeepMem，一种字节级语言模型的多尺度因果架构：用可逆子带变换构建短序列层级，并以无损载波与显式细节边带保留精确字节信息，在压缩瓶颈处迭代共享状态计算，再由注意力超分辨率解码器恢复字节级表示。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「语义压缩＋细节边带」的可逆多尺度设计可供核查 latent 推理中的视觉旁路与信息坍缩问题，瓶颈处迭代共享状态也可能迁移到压缩工作区的循环计算与动态算力分配。

title: DualWorldBench: Can Agents Plan Deliveries across Symbolic and Grounded Worlds?
summary: Recent multimodal agents have shown promising progress in embodied planning and web interaction. However, existing evaluations often rely on simplified tasks with limited combinatorial structure, leaving it unclear whether current agents can robustly integrate perception and reasoning for multi-goal planning under temporal, physical, and multimodal constraints. We introduce DualWorldBench, a unified benchmark for evaluating agent planning under controlled symbolic--temporal and grounded--topological complexity. Built around a shared pickup--delivery interface, DualWorldBench consists of three complementary components: TextWorld, which isolates symbolic planning under varying task compositions and release dynamics; SimWorld, which evaluates grounded path planning under controlled topological variation with text, image, or multimodal inputs; and DualWorld-VQA, a diagnostic suite spanning perception, scene understanding, and planning. Experiments reveal a common gap between local understanding and globally consistent planning. In TextWorld, agents struggle to derive optimal task sequences under interacting temporal constraints; in SimWorld, grounded observations are not reliably converted into feasible action sequences. DualWorld-VQA further confirms that perception and topology understanding do not necessarily translate into constrained planning. Together, these results identify the central challenge as composing symbolic or grounded evidence into globally feasible and efficient multi-goal plans. These findings establish DualWorldBench as a challenging testbed for agents with tighter perception--reasoning--planning integration. All datasets and code are publicly available at our project website https://dualworld.netlify.app/.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出 DualWorldBench，以共享的取送任务接口统一评估智能体在符号—时间约束和具身—拓扑约束下的多目标规划，并另设 DualWorld-VQA 诊断感知、场景理解与规划，结果显示局部理解难以转化为全局可行的计划。

title: Beyond Token Representations: Explicit Visual Object Grounding for Video Reasoning Segmentation
summary: Video Reasoning Segmentation (VRS) aims to infer and segment target objects specified by reasoning queries in videos. Existing methods typically first infer the target and generate a few segmentation tokens for it, which are then fed into a mask decoder for mask prediction. However, such segmentation tokens tend to be both semantically monotonous and spatially ambiguous, making them largely insufficient to represent the target to guide mask prediction. In this paper, we propose an explicit visual object grounding framework for VRS. Specifically, we first propose a spatial-aware prompt generation and refinement scheme, in which we query a multimodal large language model to generate explicit spatial prompts (i.e., bounding box and point set) for the target and then refine them through multi-step dialogue. Furthermore, we introduce a query diversification and alignment module to generate auxiliary queries that describe the same target from different perspectives. We then enforce cross-query consistency between their predicted spatial prompts to alleviate the training bias caused by query limitations. Finally, we select several reliable frames using a prompt-based keyframe selection strategy to support mask decoding and propagation. Extensive experiments on eight datasets demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods. The code is available at https://github.com/viscom-tongji/EVOG.

AI.brief_summary: 提出面向视频推理分割的显式目标 grounding 框架：让 MLLM 通过多步对话生成并细化空间 prompt（边界框与点集），辅以查询多样化与跨查询一致性约束，再用 prompt 引导的关键帧选择支持掩码解码与传播。

title: Spatial Memory for AR Glasses: Hierarchical Visual Acquisition and Source-Linked Recall
summary: We present a spatial-memory system that enables optical see-through AR glasses to recall earlier physical encounters. The dual-camera prototype combines hierarchical visual acquisition with source-linked storage and staged retrieval. Quality screen-ing, global and regional appearance novelty, and temporal support select monochrome observations for detailed RGB cap-ture. Semantic observations retain links to their source images, allowing retrieval to answer indexed historical questions direct-ly or inspect visual details omitted from scene descriptions. The architecture separates capture acceptance, interpretation out-come, and support for a particular question. This distinction motivates two core control mechanisms: bounded reassessment of familiar views when earlier processing leaves an evidence gap, and retention guided by source dependencies. In a 131.35 s egocentric replay, the implemented acquisition policy selected six RGB views from 648 monitoring observations, while feature extraction ran on 97.7% of observations. These results demon-strate selective RGB acquisition and identify frequent local inference as a remaining cost. Exposure duration and cross-view timing further constrain the evidence preserved from se-lected encounters. The system provides a practical acquisition-to-recall architecture for persistent AR assistance, with explicit boundaries between captured evidence, indexed interpretations, and supported historical claims.

AI.brief_summary: 提出面向AR眼镜的空间记忆系统：双摄像头分级视觉采集、带源链接的存储与分阶段检索，使系统能直接回答历史视觉问题或回查被描述省略的原始图像细节；131秒自我中心回放中从648次监测观察里选出6帧RGB。

title: EP-LVMQA: Evidence-Preserving Coarse-to-Fine Localization for Low-Quality Long Video Moment Question Answering
summary: Long instructional videos are increasingly used in medical education, industrial training, and procedural knowledge transfer, yet their evidence is often incomplete or unreliable: subtitles may be missing, ASR noisy, OCR sparse, and decisive actions briefly shown without narration. Existing VideoQA systems typically return labels or free-form text, making answer support difficult to inspect. We study Long Video Moment Question Answering (LVMQA), where a system returns timestamped answer-supporting evidence. We propose EP-LVMQA, an evidence-preserving coarse-to-fine framework comprising an Uncertainty-Aware Multimodal Evidence Timeline, a Coarse Evidence Planner, and an Evidence-Conditioned Fine Localizer. An evidence card transfers planner scores, matched cues, source-confidence proxies, modality-specific evidence, neighboring context, and a temporal prior between the latter two modules. On MedVidQA, EP-LVMQA achieves 26.1 R1@0.5 and 31.8 mIoU, improving the strongest non-ours results by 6.3 and 5.1 points. It raises Suff.@2 and Ver.@2 to 25.4 and 22.6, gains of 9.5 and 8.8 points. Under matched low-quality perturbations, average relative degradation is reduced from the strongest non-ours value of 14.6% to 11.1%. On Ego4D-NLQ and QVHighlights, EP-LVMQA remains broadly comparable to established task-specific localization methods.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 EP-LVMQA，面向字幕缺失、ASR 噪声等低质量长视频的时刻问答，构建不确定性感知的多模态证据时间线，并用粗到细规划与定位返回带时间戳的支撑证据。

title: Factorized MLLM Embeddings for Composed Image Retrieval
summary: Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) aims to retrieve a target image given a reference image and a modification text. Although recent approaches leveraging Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown significant progress, we argue that the MLLM's compositional understanding remains underutilized. This stems from directly mapping composed queries into a retrieval embedding via contrastive supervision alone, without explicitly resolving the intended visual modifications. In this work, we introduce Factorized MLLM Embeddings (FactEmbed), which decouples compositional query comprehension from building discriminative embeddings. Rather than directly projecting the composed query into a single embedding without internal reasoning, FactEmbed employs a set of factorized latents that simulate the intended visual modifications via an intermediate target imagination objective. This process encourages the latents to ground into target semantics before forming discriminative representations for retrieval. Subsequently, to propagate these factorized representations throughout the model for retrieval, we optimize a factor-level contrastive loss while distilling the decomposed representations into a deeper attention layer of the MLLM. Finally, for efficient inference, we retain the [EOS] token to establish a global-level embedding on top of these factorized latents, while we exploit the mean-pooled factorized latents to rerank a short candidate list at negligible cost, as both are produced by the same forward pass. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that FactEmbed outperforms prior works across CIR benchmarks.

AI.brief_summary: 论文面向组合图像检索（CIR），提出 FactEmbed，将组合查询理解与判别嵌入构建解耦：用一组分解 latent 经「目标想象」中间目标模拟预期视觉修改，配合 factor 级对比损失并蒸馏到更深注意力层，推理时以 [EOS] 全局嵌入检索、用 latent 均值池化重排候选。

title: JHiMA-WebRL: A Joint Hierarchical Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Framework for Long-Horizon Web Tasks
summary: Multimodal web agents have shown promising capabilities for interacting with websites through graphical user interfaces (GUIs), yet realistic web tasks often require long-horizon, multi-step planning that remains challenging for monolithic policies. Such agents must jointly infer high-level plans, navigate through intermediate states, track progress over extended interaction histories, and execute visually grounded actions. Although prior work has explored modular multi-agent systems with a separate planner, the planner is typically not updated jointly with the actor. We investigate whether explicitly separating and jointly training planning and execution provides a stronger inductive bias for long-horizon web navigation. We introduce JHiMA-WebRL, a joint hierarchical multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for web agents that couples a task decomposer with an actor. To train the decomposer, we use a strong teacher model to construct structured subtask supervision from multimodal GUI trajectories, and use these annotations to fine-tune both the decomposer and the subtask-conditioned actor. We then extend Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to jointly optimize the decomposer and actor in the interactive WebArena environment through hierarchical rollout grouping and role-specific advantages. On WebArena-Lite-v2, JHiMA-WebRL-14B, consisting of a 7B actor and a 7B decomposer, achieves an average success rate of 37.2%, compared with 24% for a ScaleCUA-32B agent that we fine-tune with RL on the same training tasks and evaluate under the same protocol. Ablations show that jointly updating the decomposer during RL outperforms updating the actor alone. These results suggest that jointly learned role factorization with smaller models can be a competitive alternative to scaling monolithic agents for long-horizon web tasks.

title: YANAMI: A Large-Scale Multimodal Dataset and Benchmark for Multiturn Stateful Interaction
summary: Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) integrate visual understanding, generation, and editing within a single unified framework. However, existing unified multimodal datasets and benchmarks remain dominated by single-turn tasks. Even in recent multi-turn datasets, many turns can be solved independently without tracking information across turns. Consequently, they provide limited supervision and evaluation for multimodal stateful interaction, which requires models to understand, maintain, update, and faithfully realize evolving dialogue states across turns. To address this gap, we introduce YANAMI, the first large-scale multimodal dialogue dataset and benchmark for stateful interaction, comprising YANAMI-400K and YANAMI-Bench. YANAMI-400K contains 400K multi-turn multimodal dialogues, with more than 2M images and 2.6M dialogue turns. The dialogues span four representative scenarios: Multi-Image Fusion, Image Editing, World Modeling, and Visual Reasoning, and require models to continuously track, preserve, and revise evolving multimodal dialogue states across turns. YANAMI-Bench comprises 400 multi-turn dialogues for systematically evaluating multimodal stateful interaction. It jointly evaluates Dialogue State Understanding and Visual Realization, characterizing the gap between models' ability to understand evolving dialogue states and their ability to faithfully realize them in visual outputs. Experiments show that fine-tuning BAGEL on YANAMI-400K improves image editing, generation, and multimodal stateful interaction by 10.3%, 2.0%, and 13.23%, respectively, while preserving its general visual understanding capabilities. Evaluations on YANAMI-Bench further reveal that existing UMMs still struggle to maintain, update, and visually realize evolving multimodal dialogue states.

AI.brief_summary: 构建 YANAMI 大规模多轮多模态对话数据集与基准，覆盖图像融合、编辑、世界建模和视觉推理，评估模型跨轮理解、维持并视觉实现对话状态的能力。

title: Zero-Gated Cross-Attention
summary: Injecting non-text modalities into frozen language models often introduces early optimization instability, making it difficult to separate architectural gains from transient training dynamics. We introduce Inductively Gated Cross-Attention (IGCA), a zero-initialized cross-attention bridge that preserves pretrained model behavior at initialization while enabling gradual multimodal conditioning. Integrated across six decoder layers of frozen Falcon-40B, open_llama_30b, and Bloom-7b1 backbones (with 40,404,961,288 trainable adapter parameters used during training), IGCA acts as an exact algebraic no-op at initialization with a maximum output discrepancy of 0.00e+00. Over 59,500 training steps on Falcon-40B, the training loss decreases from 3.9403 to 0.0007 (with final ten step losses of [0.0001, 0.0003, 0.0005, 0.0002, 0.0005, 0.0011, 0.0005, 0.0006, 0.0005, 0.0007]). On held-out evaluation, the best gate-on checkpoint achieves a loss of 2.2201 compared to 4.3469 for the gate-off baseline -- a 48.9% reduction (2.1268 nats) -- while average held-out loss improves from 4.3423 to 2.2498 (1.9075 nats) with a mean gate magnitude of $\vert{}\tanh(α)\vert{} = 0.0713$.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Inductively Gated Cross-Attention（IGCA）：在冻结语言模型的六个解码层插入零初始化门控交叉注意力桥，使初始输出与预训练模型完全一致，再逐步引入非文本模态条件，并在三个骨干模型上报告 held-out loss 下降。

title: Latent Cluster Separation as a Regularizer for Lifelong Anomaly Detection
summary: Lifelong (continual) anomaly detection systems must learn a sequence of tasks without forgetting how to recognize anomaly types seen earlier -- a property known as backward transfer. A common way to try to improve backward transfer is to reshape a model's internal representation around learnable concept centroids, typically coupled with a new way of scoring anomalies based on distance to those centroids. Because these two design choices are usually introduced together, it is unclear which one is actually responsible for any performance gain. In this paper, we unbundle the two mechanisms within a VAE-based lifelong anomaly detector and study them separately. We find that used purely as a training-time regularizer -- while leaving anomaly scoring unchanged -- latent cluster separation can improve detection quality and backward transfer, though whether it outperforms the alternative scoring approach depends on the dataset's underlying representation. Switching to distance-based scoring is instead where most of the instability commonly associated with this class of method actually originates; we identify and explain the underlying mechanism. This benefit depends on the dataset's underlying representation, and we report this as practical guidance for choosing between the two design choices, rather than as a list of caveats.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在基于 VAE 的终身/持续异常检测器中解耦两种常被捆绑的设计——围绕可学习概念质心重塑内部表示，以及按到质心距离进行异常打分——分别考察其对检测质量与后向迁移的作用，发现仅作训练期正则时仍可提升检测与后向迁移，而距离打分才是该类方法不稳定性的主要来源，并给出机制解释与选择建议。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「训练期 latent 正则」与「推理期读出方式」分开消融、做贡献归因的做法，可能为 LVR 中区分 latent 状态训练的收益与答案读出/打分机制的影响提供可核查的方法线索，也涉及潜在表示几何与状态组织；但研究对象为单模态异常检测，与 VLM 推理无直接联系。

title: Mixture of Wide Experts: Sparse Routing for Interpretable Native Coordinates
comment: 47 pages, 14 figures. Code: https://github.com/FAIRC-Research/mowe. Models: https://huggingface.co/FAIRC
summary:
Language models often spread a concept across many internal dimensions, making their features difficult to interpret. Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) recover clearer features after training. We ask whether models can instead learn interpretable output coordinates directly. We introduce Mixture of Wide Experts (MoWE), a sparse feed-forward layer in which selected experts read the full representation but write to fixed, disjoint output coordinates. On a controlled task with known hidden causes, this design preserves predictive performance while localizing causes more clearly than dense and standard mixture-of-experts (MoE) models.
  At approximately matched compute, we train two 19-layer runs of each architecture for 10 billion tokens. MoWE achieves evaluation cross-entropy 2.417 versus 2.452 for dense, while standard MoE reaches 2.22.
  We measure native-coordinate readability by asking a language-model judge to describe each coordinate from passages where it is strongly active and test that description on new passages. Correcting for descriptions that also fit other coordinates gives a specificity score of 0.523 for MoWE, 0.375 for dense, and 0.268 for standard MoE. TopK SAEs trained on the same FFN updates score 0.489 for dense and 0.556 for MoWE, making native MoWE comparable to the dense SAE.
  In the first case study, we identify a four-coordinate causal path supporting the model's prediction of degrees after the prompt A right angle is 90. We then copy seven angle-related coordinate values into the model as it processes A rectangle has four, changing its next-token prediction from sides to degrees. In the second, one fixed coordinate set detects hazardous requests and another steers the next token toward refusal. These examples show that MoWE combines sparse conditional computation with coordinates that can be identified and reused directly.

title: Learning Directional Randers Geometry for Latent-Space Exploration
summary: Deep neural networks extract powerful latent representations from images, enabling fast and efficient downstream analysis. However, these latent spaces lack explicit geometric structure, leading to possibly poor interpolation fidelity and misleading extrapolation. Latent interpolation techniques assume symmetric transition costs which are often not the case for real world data. Their symmetric nature cannot capture directional processes, such as disease progression, where certain transitions are impossible (e.g. tumor growth dynamics or cognitive improvement in Alzheimer's disease). Although Riemannian metrics extend Euclidean geometry by incorporating curvature, they remain symmetric. We show that understanding asymmetry and not curvature alone directly addresses these problems. To do so we propose a new Finsler-Randers metric learning framework. It incorporates direction-dependent distances, thus enabling the computation of trajectories respecting monotonic sequential constraints. We demonstrate its potential for interpolation and extrapolation on controlled cross-sectional datasets.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Finsler–Randers 度量学习框架，为图像潜空间学习方向依赖的非对称距离，并在受控横断面数据上生成满足单调顺序约束的插值和外推轨迹。
AI.relevance_reason: 其非对称潜空间度量可能为 LVR 中方向性状态转移、轨迹约束与 latent 相似度评估提供方法线索，但需核查其在高维 VLM 潜状态和推理过程中的可扩展性与实际作用。

title: Functional-Group Knowledge Is Structured in Language Models Before It Is Spoken
summary: Language models serve as the reasoning core of agents for chemistry and materials science, where they must interpret molecular structure before planning syntheses or proposing materials. Yet their outputs show only what they say, not what they know. Given a prompt such as ``The primary functional group in 1-Fluorobutane (CCCCF) is'', a small general-purpose model may answer ``the alkyne group'' instead of an alkyl fluoride. The output alone cannot tell whether the model failed to recognize the fluorine or recognized it and failed to say so. We address this by reading the internal representations of five open-source models on prompts covering 92 molecules and 20 functional groups. Even without chemistry training, the models organize functional groups by chemical family, and they encode chemical differences as consistent directions. The shift from thioether ($\mathrm{R{-}S{-}R'}$) to thiol ($\mathrm{R{-}SH}$), added to ether ($\mathrm{R{-}O{-}R'}$), lands nearest alcohol ($\mathrm{R{-}OH}$). This structure emerges abruptly in the middle layers, where representations shift from tracking the wording of the prompt to tracking the functional group. The base model names the correct functional group in only 58.5\% of prompts, the lowest of the five, yet it encodes functional-group families and preserves chemically meaningful patterns. Its errors are mostly failures to answer rather than wrong answers. Functional-group knowledge is structured in the model before it is spoken. Chemistry fine-tuning reorganizes it, making functional groups rather than prompt wording dominate the representation. These results suggest that evaluating chemical language models through outputs alone can underestimate the chemical information they encode. Representation analysis can distinguish a lack of knowledge from a failure to express it, which matters when choosing or adapting models for chemical agents.

title: Training LLM Agents to Automate LLM Post-Training with RSI-Dojo
summary: Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) aims to enable AI systems to autonomously build and improve AI systems themselves, including models, harnesses, and underlying infrastructure. Within this broader agenda, a central capability is enabling agents to train and improve base models. However, existing studies on automated model training primarily focused on workflow- or harness-level optimizations, rather than internalizing the ability to conduct post-training into the model itself. Developing this capability requires executable model training environments that can produce high-quality trajectories demonstrating how to select data, train models, diagnose failures, and iteratively improve results. In this paper, we introduce RSI-Dojo, a collection of executable model training environments designed to teach LLM agents to conduct post-training. To construct RSI-Dojo, we develop RSI-Craft, an automatic pipeline that converts human research artifacts into executable model training environments. RSI-Craft automatically collects research papers from top venues, instantiates datasets and metrics into a unified interface, and reproduces evaluation dependencies. It then filters tasks by data size, execution reliability, and discriminability, yielding RSI-Dojo with 281 seed model training tasks. Building on RSI-Dojo, we employ a trajectory collection method with an improved harness to collect high-quality model-training trajectories from frontier models, then retain examples through rubric-based and outcome-based filtering. We fine-tune Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on these trajectories. The resulting RSI-Dojo-9B and RSI-Dojo-35B-A3B improve over their base models by 8.74 and 16.87 PostTrainBench points, respectively. RSI-Dojo-35B-A3B reaches 29.95 on PostTrainBench and 53.29 on PostTrainBench-Lite, matching the performance of frontier models such as GLM-5.2 and GPT 5.5.
